annotations.title: Add an entry to the books

description: Add one income or expense entry to the business's books (POST /books/entries), e.g. a cash sale or an expense paid. Books only: nothing is paid or sent. Use the category name exactly as in Accounting (an unknown name returns the list to choose from). The business is told each time. Needs real data (live key).

category.description: The category name as shown in Accounting, e.g. Sales or Rent.
